english.note: Use this specifically for a baseball play in which a fielder touches the baserunner with the ball to put them out.

examples.english: The fielder caught the ball in his glove and made a tag on the baserunner.
examples.traditional: 守備員用手套接住個波，跟住完成觸殺。
